newsitem.title: CHINA: Nokia says China one of five biggest mkts.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says China one of five biggest mkts.

text.p: China is one of Nokia Corp's five top markets worldwide, president Jorma Ollila said on Friday.
Nokia's mobile telecommunications equipment has been introduced in six Chinese provinces, the Xinhua news agency quoted Ollila as saying in a meeting with Chinese Vice Premier Wu Bangguo.
Beijing Nokia Mobile Telecommunications Ltd. established in 1995, has produced 115,000 mobile phones, and reported 1.2 billion yuan in sales volume, he said.
Nokia will continue to expand production capacity at its joint ventures in China through technological cooperation, Ollila said.
